`enum StencilEmulation.Pass`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.state` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [StencilEmulation.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/state/StencilEmulation.java)

Which stencil code a translated fragment stage carries.

## Description

`stencil(...)` of [`GlslShaderTranslator`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/) takes it to add the code of [`StencilEmulation`](/reference/pipeline/stencilemulation/) to the fragment stage.

## Learn more

- [Stencil emulation](/build/shader-translation/#stencil-emulation)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`NONE`](#StencilEmulation-Pass-value-NONE) | No stencil code: the backend uses its own stencil buffer, or none. |
| [`TEST`](#StencilEmulation-Pass-value-TEST) | The fragment stage discards the fragments that fail the comparison against the stencil texture. |
| [`WRITE`](#StencilEmulation-Pass-value-WRITE) | The fragment stage outputs, in its red channel, the stencil value after the fail or the pass operation, to draw into the stencil texture. |

## Value details

<a id="StencilEmulation-Pass-value-NONE"></a>

### NONE

`NONE` 

No stencil code: the backend uses its own stencil buffer, or none.

<a id="StencilEmulation-Pass-value-TEST"></a>

### TEST

`TEST` 

The fragment stage discards the fragments that fail the comparison against the stencil texture.
A translator set to `TEST` also gives the `WRITE` stage in [`ShaderTranslation.getStencilFragment`](/reference/pipeline/shadertranslation/#ShaderTranslation-method-getStencilFragment).

<a id="StencilEmulation-Pass-value-WRITE"></a>

### WRITE

`WRITE` 

The fragment stage outputs, in its red channel, the stencil value after the fail or the pass operation, to draw into the stencil texture.
